'''Bry''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who was a member of [[Galaar Squad]], trained by a [[Unidentified Corellian Cuy'val Dar instructor|Corellian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' to fight for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
After [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was enacted and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] established the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Bry, along with squadmate [[Ennen]], were combined with [[Omega Squad]]'s [[Niner Skirata|Niner]], and [[Darman Skirata]] to form [[Squad 40]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="IC 501st" />

On their [[Mission to Celen|first]] mission as a squad, they were sent to the planet [[Celen]] to capture [[Jilam Kester]], an [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] who was helping [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escape capture from the Empire. Upon storming the Kester's [[Jilam Kester's base|residence]], the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] came face to face with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Iri Camas]], who had previously commanded the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]]. After initially engaging Camas, Bry circled around to outflank the Jedi Master by gaining entry via a front window. However, Bry's attack on Camas was unsuccessful, as the Jedi appeared to be wearing armor which deflected his gauntlet vibroblade. Camas stabbed Bry in the chest with his lightsaber and Force threw him through an exterior wall. Despite Ennen's attempts to revive him, his injuries proved fatal.<ref name="IC 501st" />

Following his death, his body was returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where Ennen demanded he be [[Cremation/Legends|cremated]] per the tradition of a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] in exile, a heritage the two commandos clung to from their training sergeant. Squad 40's new commanding officer following the disappearance of [[Sa Cuis]], [[Roly Melusar]], gave Bry the proper cremation, putting the man to rest.<ref name="IC 501st" />
